summary_en: This study tests the Embr Wave, a wearable thermal device that gives a cooling sensation on the wrist, for hot flashes in men with prostate cancer who are receiving androgen deprivation therapy. Participants are randomized 1:1 to use the device right away for 12 weeks or to start it after 6 weeks of usual care. The study aims to find out whether the device reduces hot flash symptoms, measured with patient-reported outcomes; the phase is not applicable (NA).
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa el Embr Wave, un dispositivo térmico portátil que produce una sensación de enfriamiento en la muñeca, para los sofocos en hombres con cáncer de próstata que reciben terapia de privación androgénica. Los participantes se asignan al azar en una proporción 1:1 para usar el dispositivo de inmediato durante 12 semanas o para empezarlo después de 6 semanas de atención habitual. El estudio busca determinar si el dispositivo reduce los síntomas de sofocos, medidos con resultados reportados por los pacientes; la fase no aplica (NA).
who_for: Men with prostate cancer on androgen deprivation therapy for at least 4 weeks
Must stay on androgen deprivation therapy for the 12-week study
At least 28 hot flashes per week, at least moderately bothersome, for 30 days or more before entry
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status of 2 or less
Able to understand and willing to sign written informed consent
not_for: Another diagnosis, including a separate cancer, that may limit life expectancy to under 6 months
Systemic cancer therapy other than approved androgen receptor pathway inhibitors, radioligand therapy, or immunotherapy
Clinical trial participation using standard options in those therapy categories is allowed
